subtitle: A habit tracker app you can change by asking your AI.
about: A small app inside a Pinto Notes note, with daily ticks and a month view. Connect your AI to log habits in chat, or tick them off yourself.

ask.prompt: Add the Pinto Notes habit tracker template with my habits: walk, read, 8 glasses of water.

slides.label: Log your day
slides.you: Walked and read 20 pages this morning. 4 glasses of water so far.
slides.ai: Ticked off Walk and Read. Water is at 4 of 8 for today.
slides.alt: Today: Walk and Read ticked, Water at 4 of 8

slides.label: Ask for a year view
slides.you: Can my habit tracker show a year view for each habit?
slides.ai: Your habit tracker now has a year view for each habit.
slides.alt: The year view the AI added

before.alt: The month view, before the change

slides.label: Add a habit
slides.ai: I added Stretching. Today is Saturday, so it won't show as due until Monday.

slides.label: Use it yourself
slides.note: Or tick and edit it yourself.
